briefs.claim_en: Under the Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026, the government is providing free laptops to all students.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including the PIB Fact Check unit and various news outlets (shiksha.com, timesnownews.com, livemint.com, hindustantimes.com, newsonair.gov.in, abplive.com), state that the claim about the Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026 providing free laptops to all students is false. The Government of India has not announced any such scheme. Fact-checking organizations like Alt News and Vishvas News have also debunked similar claims dating back to 2019, 2023, 2024, and 2025, identifying them as scams or phishing attempts. While some Indian state governments may have their own free laptop or tablet schemes, there is no central government initiative for this purpose.

briefs.claim_en: The last date to apply for the Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026 is October 15.
briefs.brief_en: According to the PIB Fact Check unit and various news sources (shiksha.com, timesnownews.com, livemint.com, hindustantimes.com, newsonair.gov.in, abplive.com), there is no official "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026" by the Government of India. Consequently, there is no application deadline of October 15 for such a scheme. These claims are frequently debunked as fake news and scams. While some state-level schemes or scholarship programs might have application deadlines around October, they are not related to a central government free laptop scheme.

briefs.claim_en: To apply for the Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026, one must register their name on the website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in.
briefs.brief_en: The website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is not an official government website for any "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026." The PIB Fact Check unit and news outlets (shiksha.com, timesnownews.com, livemint.com, hindustantimes.com, newsonair.gov.in, abplive.com) have consistently identified such websites as fake and fraudulent, designed to mislead people and collect personal information. Official government websites in India typically end with ".gov.in."
